name: Shenir
overview: Shenir, also called Senir, is the Amorite name for Mount Hermon, a significant mountain referenced in Scripture. The name appears in various contexts, including territorial boundaries where the half tribe of Manasseh settled (1 Chronicles 5:23), poetic imagery in the Song of Solomon (4:8), and as a source of valuable timber used for shipbuilding (Ezekiel 27:5). Deuteronomy 3:9 highlights the different names given to this mountain by surrounding peoples, emphasizing its prominence in the ancient Near Eastern landscape.
